title: Peanut Butter Cheesecake
hookLine: United States-inspired peanut butter cheesecake with 10 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Melt & Whisk Smooth
steps.instructionTemplate: Oil and line a 20cm round loose- bottomed cake tin with cling film, making it as smooth as possible. Melt the butter in a pan. Crush the biscuits by bashing them in a bag with a rolling pin, then stir them into the butter until very well coated. Press the mixture firmly into the base of the tin and chill. Soak the gelatine in water while you make the filling. Tip the ricotta into a bowl, then beat in the peanut butter and syrup. Ricotta has a slightly grainy texture so blitz until smooth with a stick blender for a smoother texture if you prefer. Incorporate {m52861_1}, {m52861_2}, {m52861_3}, and {m52861_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Chill Until Firmly Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Take the soaked gelatine from the water and squeeze dry. Put it into a pan with the milk and heat very gently until the gelatine dissolves. Beat into the peanut mixture, then tip onto the biscuit base. Chill until set. To freeze, leave in the tin and as soon as it is solid, cover the surface with cling film, then wrap the tin with cling film and foil. Incorporate {m52861_5} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {m52861_6}, {m52861_7}, {m52861_8}, {m52861_9}, and {m52861_10} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: To defrost, thaw in the fridge overnight. To serve, carefully remove from the tin. Whisk the cream with the sugar until it holds its shape, then spread on top of the cheesecake and scatter with the peanut brittle.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Dip a sharp knife in hot water and wipe dry between every cut for razor-clean cafe slices.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
